nuggets.text: The Owls sacked Penn State quarterback Christian Hackenberg 10 times in their 27-10 win at the Linc in 2015.
The Owls' 2015 win over Penn State was their first against the Nittany Lions since 1941.
Owls coach K.C. Keeler is the only coach in FCS history to win national titles at two schools.
K.C. Keeler played linebacker at Delaware and was on its 1979 Division II national championship team.
Jamarcus Pierre and Tyree Alualu both returned interceptions for touchdowns in the Owls' win over Rhode Island.
Coach Glenn 'Pop' Warner led the Owls from 1933 to 1938, after winning national titles at Pitt and Stanford.
The Owls have two mascots: the costumed Hooter T. Owl and a live mascot named Stella.
The Owls' 2015 win over Penn State drew 69,176 fans, a record for a Temple home game at the time.
Keveun Mason ran for 158 yards and two touchdowns in the Owls' 38-14 opener against Rhode Island.
